description: This Java class defines the FeaturesModifiedStrategy, which handles FeaturesModified events in the Ditto framework. It extends an abstract strategy class and updates features in a ThingBuilder object based on the received event.

classes.name: FeaturesModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing an immutable strategy to handle FeaturesModified events by updating features in a ThingBuilder.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to apply a FeaturesModified event to a ThingBuilder, removing all existing features and setting new features from the event.
